rootCause.mirroredDoor119: Pinned SDK c9c5979 SmPrimitiveCreation::CreateLinearSweep (SmPrimitiveCreation.cpp:1258-1340) makes SmPlane only for a line orthogonal to the sweep and SmCylinder only for a full circle; the door's semicircular head (a partial arc) becomes SmSurfOfExtrusion. native/smlib-adapter/src/affine.cpp surface_class whitelists BSpline/plane/cylinder/cone/sphere/torus only, so opcode 18 throws IFCLITE_SMLIB_UNSUPPORTED (7).
rootCause.adapterFixRejected: SmSurfOfExtrusion derives from SmBSplineSurface and MakeNurb builds its NURBS exactly, so a whitelist entry would be mathematically sound. But the certificate is a fixed ABI (uint32 source_classes[12]) carried through ifclite_smlib.h, the worker/browser protocol, geometry-runtime and rust/geometry decoders. That is not a small M10-scoped adapter change.

resolution.mirroredDoor119: Refused typed `incomplete` in predispatch, before any invocation: any Affine operation whose source lineage contains a format-1 sweep with a partial arc or an oblique direction. Never kernel_failure, never a partial product.
resolution.curvedScaleUps: The preregistered contraction-only chord fallback (sigma_max <= 1 for curved lineages) is source-determined, so #74, h12 #147, h13 #161 and h14 #175 refuse `incomplete` before any invocation; admit() still re-checks after drive. The original committed+1 publication target for #74 is NOT met.
